## Concrete Actionable Findings

### Group 1: Notice Generation and Installer Source
- **Finding G1-01 (Integration Process Defect / Resolved)**: Tool `9788ef` returned exit 1 because Git's `core.autocrlf=true` expanded LF lines into CRLF during `git apply --3way`. Documented in [`integrator/TWO-WHEEL-NOTICE-INTEGRATION-EOL-REPAIR-BRIEF.md`](file:///C:/Users/hello/AppData/Local/AgentControlRoom/worktrees/uoink-library/e30846da-321/gemini/docs/library/proof/two-wheel-notice-integration-2026-09-13/integrator/TWO-WHEEL-NOTICE-INTEGRATION-EOL-REPAIR-BRIEF.md); tool `fa439f` restored all eight qualified after-files and verified normalized line equality before the passing checkout run `3a56e1`.
- **Finding G1-02 (Scope Limitation)**: The 10 PowerShell block cases in [`author/run_build_blocks.ps1`](file:///C:/Users/hello/AppData/Local/AgentControlRoom/worktrees/uoink-library/e30846da-321/gemini/docs/library/proof/two-wheel-notice-integration-2026-09-13/author/run_build_blocks.ps1#L40-L52) use an inert mock function (`Invoke-NoticeStandIn`) and temporary directories. They verify PowerShell control-flow, exception handling, and hash verification, but do not execute Inno Setup (`ISCC.exe`), download embedPython, or inspect an installed wheel tree.
- **Finding G1-03 (Legal & Attribution Boundary)**: Upstream license texts preserve verbatim truth: ANTLR 4.9.3 (2,699 bytes, SHA-256 `b1b379fc...`) retains its JavaScript MIT section; proxy-tools 0.1.0 (1,436 bytes, SHA-256 `a428fb8a...`) preserves its `<COPYRIGHT HOLDER>` placeholder, trailing syntax, and BSD source vs MIT metadata discrepancy. These document component provenance without constituting formal legal clearance.

### Group 2: Generated Drain and Cancellation
- **Finding G2-01 (Tooling Defect / Resolved)**: Preparation command `36af0d` returned exit 1 because PowerShell's `Set-Content` lacks a `-NoClobber` parameter. No admission file was written and no native run began. Repaired in `72420c` using `[System.IO.File]::Open(..., [System.IO.FileMode]::CreateNew)`. Cancel admission used the same repair in `4bd36d`.
- **Finding G2-02 (Documentary Accounting)**: The aggregate byte total in the initial copy plan was corrected in `COPY-BYTES-CORRECTION.md` and `COPY-BYTES-CORRECTION01-ACTUAL.json` without affecting or rerunning native observations.
- **Finding G2-03 (Scope Limitation)**: The child explicitly reports `complete_native_namespace_protection: false`. The payload consists of 328 bytes across ASCII placeholders (including 60-byte ASCII `model.bin`). These observations prove handle adoption, IPC protocol sequencing, and process isolation, but do not qualify real Whisper neural network weights, audio decoding, VAD, or durable quarantine recovery after unexpected crashes.

Production service globals remain `None` outside the context.
- **Finding G3-02 (Scope Limitation)**: The child explicitly reports `complete_native_namespace_protection: false`; `large-v3-turbo` is an unweighted policy label. The single native drain observation (`fc23ea`, exit 0, 0.9092s) does not exercise weight loading, audio decoding, VAD, native startup failure, or crash recovery.
